notes: R_YEAR_SUBMIT; year of recruitment into MWS
R_AGE_FILL; age at recruitment; one-sided valid range From=48, no To stated
R_REGION; derived; code list 1-10 UK regions
R_QUESTIONNAIRE_TYPE; code list 1=Blue/2=Aqua/3=Other; determines which questionnaire version was completed
R_DEPRIVATION_QUINTILE; derived Townsend index; code list 1-5
R_DEPRIVATION_TERTILE; derived Townsend index; code list 1-3
R_BMI; calculated kg/m2; no stated range
R_CIGS_PER_DAY; in current smokers per description; code list 1-7, no explicit not-asked code -- open item
R_ALCOHOL_DRINKS; derived weekly count from wine/lager/cider/beer/spirits
R_EXERCISE_ANY; code list 1-6 plus -1=not on questionnaire; Blue=No availability
R_EXERCISE_STRENUOUS; code list 1-6, all versions Yes, no -1 code
R_NUM_FULLTERM_PREG; derived; code list 10=10 or more (top-coded, not a sentinel)
R_BREASTFEED_EVER; code list 1=Yes/2=No/-1=not on questionnaire; Blue=No availability
R_BREASTFEED_COUNT; code list -1=unable to derive (not asked); Blue=No availability
R_BREASTFEED_DURATION months; code list -1=unable to derive (not asked); Blue=No availability
R_STERILISED_AGE; valid range from 10, no upper stated
R_HRT_START age; valid range from 25, no upper stated
R_HRT_STOP age last used; no stated range
R_HRT_LAST_USE years since; derived; no stated range
R_HIGH_BP_PREG; ever high BP when pregnant; 1=Yes/2=No
R_HIGH_BP; ever high BP when not pregnant; 1=Yes/2=No
R_TREATED_VEINS; treated now varicose veins; 1=Yes/2=No/-1=not on questionnaire (Other=No)
R_TREATED_CLOTTING; treated now clotting problems; 1=Yes/2=No/-1=not on questionnaire (Other=No)
